messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] No plots after deployment
parts:
Hi I also have the problem with plots on shiny remote server. On my local device everything works fine, but on a remote device I can onlu see the ui checkbox.
Here is a link to the app:  https://mikolajm.shinyapps.io/MCA_test/
I would be very grateful for any the help.

And a reproducible code of the app:

library(shiny)
library(FactoMineR)
library(cluster)
data(tea)

ui <- fluidPage(
  
  titlePanel("MCA"),
  
  fluidRow(
        column(6, checkboxGroupInput("Variables", "Select variables:", 
                                 names(tea), selected=c("breakfast", "tea.time"))),
      column(6, plotOutput("plot"))),
  fluidRow(
    column(12, plotOutput("dendro", height = "700px", width="1200px"))
  )
)

server <- function(input, output) {

  tea_selected <- reactive({ 
    tea[, input$Variables]
  })
  
  ##  mca
  output$plot <- renderPlot({
    library(FactoMineR)
    par(mfrow=c(2,2))
    tea.mca <- MCA(tea_selected(), ncp=9)  
  })

  ### dendro 
  
  output$dendro <- renderPlot({
    library(FactoMineR)
    library(cluster)
    
    tea.mca <- MCA(tea_selected(), ncp=9)
    classif <- agnes(tea.mca$ind$coord,method="ward")
    plot(classif,main="Dendrogram",ask=F,which.plots=2)
  })
}

# Run the application 
shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)
